subject: Waterville Road Gutter Business Violation Appeal
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met to deliberate on several residential zoning relief requests and a contested administrative appeal regarding a local business violation.

items.title: 41 Yale Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit and variance for as-built dormers that were mistakenly constructed coplanar with the exterior walls, technically creating an unpermitted third story.

items.title: 91 Waterville Road
items.summary: Continued an administrative appeal regarding a notice of violation for operating a gutter business in a residential zone after neighbors testified about noise and idling trucks.

items.title: 64 Boynton Road
items.summary: Approved a rear yard setback variance for a residential addition on an irregularly shaped triangular lot.

items.title: 9 Sturgis Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to raise the roof and wall height of a non-conforming structure to bring it up to building code.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes for March 26.
